Hong Kong: gold barely moved on the paper's verified tape, HK$40,809 a tael, while silver clawed back some of Thursday's fall.

Gold prices at HK$40,809 a tael and HK$1,090 a gram, both flat from the prior session; silver rose 0.68% to HK$16,144 a kilogram, from Kitco's spot close and the HK$/US$7.80 peg midpoint. No single story cleared the trade's attention today, so tonight's post is the tape alone.

香港金飾業界注意：本報發金牌價每兩港幣40,809元、每克1,090元，較上一交易日大致持平；白銀每公斤16,144元，回升0.68%。今日無單一新聞達到頭條門檻，故只發牌價。
